name: Zywrap AI – Excerpts, Meta Descriptions, Alt Text and Rewrites
author: zywrap

sections.description:
Zywrap writes the small things every post, page and product needs, and helps with the text you are writing. It works inside WordPress, on your own content, and nothing changes until you say so.

Start free, right inside WordPress. Enter your email, type the 6-digit code we send you, and you are connected, with 10,000 free credits. No other website to visit, no key to copy. A typical task uses between 30 and 100 credits, so that is well over a hundred tasks.

What it does

  • Finds what is missing. The Zywrap home screen and the Dashboard widget show how many posts have no excerpt or meta description and how many images have no alt text. One click fills a whole list; you approve each one.
  • Fills fields for you. Excerpt, SEO title, meta description, focus keyphrase, social share title and description (in Yoast SEO or Rank Math), URL slug, tags and categories chosen from your own, image alt text, captions and titles.
  • Fixes and rewrites your text. Select a paragraph and pick proofread, say it in fewer words, expand, make it simpler, friendlier, more professional or more persuasive, translate, or turn it into a list. Replace the paragraph with the result, or put it below; Undo brings the original back.
  • Makes something new from your post. Key takeaways, TL;DR, FAQ section, table of contents, social posts for X, LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram, a newsletter blurb, an announcement email and more.
  • Writes for WooCommerce. Short and long product descriptions, product meta descriptions, benefit bullets, product FAQs and alt text for product photos, from the product’s own details.
  • Answers comments and reviews. Tells you whether a comment needs a reply, and drafts one into WordPress’s own reply box for you to check and post. Product reviews get a positive or a negative-review reply.

You stay in charge

  • Every result is shown first. Use it, edit it, try again or discard it.
  • Every saved change can be undone.
  • Zywrap never publishes anything and never posts a reply by itself.

Where you find it

  • While writing: the chat icon in the editor’s top toolbar, or the round chat button in the corner. The sidebar shows what the post still needs, tools for the selected text, and every task.
  • On a paragraph: the Zywrap menu in the block toolbar.
  • Anywhere in the editor: press Ctrl+K (Cmd+K on a Mac) and type “Zywrap”.
  • Before publishing: the publish check lists anything still empty.
  • Classic editor and WooCommerce products: a Zywrap box under Publish.
  • In lists: “Fill with Zywrap” under each post, page and product that is missing something, and “Reply with Zywrap” under each comment.
  • Media Library: “Write with Zywrap” under Alternative Text, Title and Caption.

Works with

Yoast SEO, Rank Math, WooCommerce, the block editor and the Classic Editor.

Zywrap Enterprise

Enterprise accounts also get the Playground: every AI template in the Zywrap catalogue, with a choice of AI models and settings, and saved presets. It is linked from Zywrap > Settings once your account includes it.

External Services

This plugin uses Zywrap, a service run by WiselyHub LLC, to write and edit text with AI. Nothing is sent when the plugin is activated, and nothing is ever sent about your site’s visitors. Every request below starts with something a logged-in user does in wp-admin.

Creating an account or signing in from wp-admin

Only when an administrator presses “Create my free account”, after ticking the box to accept Zywrap’s Terms and Privacy Policy.

  • Asking for a code: the email address and optional name typed into the form, your site’s address, and a one-time security value (a PKCE challenge, which contains no personal data). Zywrap emails a 6-digit code to that address. A new account is created only when the code is entered.
  • Entering the code: the code, the matching security value, and your site’s address. Zywrap returns an API key for this site, the account’s email address and its credit balance, which are stored in your WordPress database (options zywrap_api_key and zywrap_account).

Connecting in the browser (zywrap.com)

Only when an administrator clicks “Connect with zywrap.com instead”. The browser goes to https://zywrap.com/connect/wordpress to sign up or sign in and approve the site.

  • Sent in that link: your site’s address and name, the wp-admin address to come back to, two one-time security values (a random state and a PKCE challenge, which contain no personal data), and tags showing the visit came from this plugin.
  • Anything typed on zywrap.com is given to Zywrap directly, under Zywrap’s own terms.

Zywrap API (api.zywrap.com)

  • Finishing a browser connection: the one-time code, the matching security value, and your site’s address. Zywrap returns an API key, the account’s email address and its credit balance, stored as above.
  • Checking a key entered by hand: when you click “Verify and save”, the key is sent to confirm it works.
  • Running a task: the API key, which task it is, any options chosen, and the content the task works on, listed below. Zywrap passes this content to the AI provider that produces the result (for example OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or Groq) and keeps a usage record for billing.
    • Post tasks: the post’s text (up to a word limit), title, post type, and category and tag names. Depending on the task, also the post’s public link (published posts only), the names of the site’s tags or categories, the titles of recent posts, the focus keyphrase from Yoast SEO or Rank Math, and the site’s name and tagline.
    • Product tasks (WooCommerce): the product’s name, short and long description and visible attributes. Prices are never sent.
    • Image tasks: the image’s file name, alt text, title and caption, and the title of the post it belongs to (for product images, the product’s name and attributes).
    • Comment tasks: the comment’s text and author name, and the title and opening of the post it is on (to summarise a thread, the post’s approved comments and their authors’ names).
    • Anything typed into a task’s own fields, such as the language to translate into.
    • Playground and Zywrap AI window (Enterprise): whatever is typed into the form.
  • Downloading the catalogue (Enterprise only): only when you click “Download the catalogue” or “Update now” on the Playground: the API key and the version of the catalogue already on your site.

Zywrap Terms of Service: https://zywrap.com/terms
Zywrap Privacy Policy: https://zywrap.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Zywrap” and click Install, then Activate.
  2. Open the Zywrap menu. Check the email address, tick the box to accept the Terms, and press “Create my free account”.
  3. Enter the 6-digit code from the email. Your site is connected and new accounts start with 10,000 free credits. If you already have a Zywrap account, the same steps sign you in.
  4. Try a task on one of your own posts right there, or open any post and click the chat icon in the toolbar.

Sign in with Google or GitHub, or use two-factor authentication? Choose “Connect with zywrap.com instead”. Already have an API key? Choose “I already have an API key” under Zywrap > Settings.
sections.faq:
Is it free?

You start with 10,000 free credits, enough for well over a hundred tasks. After that you can add credits or choose a plan on zywrap.com. Zywrap > Settings shows how many credits you have left, and Zywrap > Usage shows what each task cost.

Will it change my posts without asking?

No. Every result is shown to you first, and nothing is saved until you press “Use this”. Every saved change can be undone, and Zywrap never publishes posts or posts comment replies.

Do I need to write prompts?

No. Each task already knows its job. You pick it, and some ask one short question first, such as the language to translate into.

Does it work with Yoast SEO and Rank Math?

Yes. The SEO title, meta description, focus keyphrase and social fields are written into the SEO plugin you use, and the editor shows them straight away.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. It writes short and long product descriptions, product meta descriptions and alt text for product photos from the product’s own details (prices are never sent), and replies to product reviews.

Does it work with the Classic Editor?

Yes. Classic edit screens and WooCommerce products get a Zywrap box with the same tools as the block editor sidebar.

Can Zywrap see my images?

No. For alt text, captions and titles it works from the file name, the existing text and the post or product the image belongs to, so check that the result describes the picture before you save it.

Who can use it?

Anyone who can edit a post can use the tasks on that post. The Zywrap screens, the Dashboard widget and the account settings are for administrators.

Zywrap cannot connect from my local or staging site

Local environments often use a self-signed certificate that PHP refuses. Add this to a small mu-plugin on that environment only:

add_filter( 'zywrap_sslverify', '__return_false' );

Never use this on a live site: it turns off certificate checks for calls to Zywrap.

Where do I report security bugs?

Please report security bugs through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team will help with verification, CVE assignment and letting us know.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • New: create your account or sign in from inside WordPress with an emailed code, with 10,000 free credits for new accounts.
  • New: 100 tasks written and tested for WordPress, from SEO fields and alt text to rewrites, social posts and comment replies.
  • New: a redesigned editor sidebar that shows what each post still needs, with one-click Write buttons and tools for the selected text.
  • New: a Zywrap menu on paragraphs, headings and lists to proofread, shorten, rewrite, change the tone or translate them in place, with Undo.
  • New: “Fill with Zywrap” on the Posts, Pages and Products lists, “Reply with Zywrap” on comments and reviews, and “Write with Zywrap” in the Media Library.
  • New: a Zywrap box on Classic Editor and WooCommerce product screens, alt text for product photos, and a Dashboard widget.
  • New: SEO fields are written straight into Yoast SEO or Rank Math.
  • New: the command palette (Ctrl+K) runs any task, and the publish check lists anything still empty.
  • Simpler: the Zywrap menu is now Home, Content Tasks, Usage and Settings, and shows your credits wherever you use them.
  • Changed: the Playground and catalogue download are for Zywrap Enterprise accounts.
  • Fixed: in the Media Library window, a saved alt text could be replaced by the old one on the next edit.
  • Privacy: the setup video is no longer embedded in wp-admin.

1.3.0

  • New: one-click connect from zywrap.com, with no key to copy.
  • New: a Get Started screen to try three tasks on your latest post.
  • Security: the settings page no longer prints the saved API key into the page.
  • Privacy: the chart library loads from the plugin instead of a CDN.

1.2.0

  • New: Content Tasks, one-click tasks that run on the post you are editing.
  • New: the Zywrap sidebar in the block editor and a check before publishing.
  • New: review, apply and undo for every task.
  • Security: tasks check permissions for the post being edited and are rate limited.

1.1.0

  • New: choice of AI models, forms that adapt to each template, and tone, style, length and complexity settings.
  • New: redesigned Playground and editor window.

1.0.2

  • Fixed: streaming responses from the API.
  • New: faster catalogue updates that download only what changed.

1.0.1

  • Fixed: the language setting was ignored.
  • Fixed: the default AI model fallback.

1.0.0

  • First release.
